lessons.title: PyPI, GitHub, and conda-forge
lessons.description: Choose the official source for a packaged release, desktop installer, development branch, or future conda-forge package.
objectives: Identify the official PyPI package and GitHub repository.
Distinguish stable releases from the nightly branch.
Understand the current conda-forge publication status.
lessons.prerequisite: No installation is required.

scenes.narration: Before installing spaCR, know the three official distribution routes: PyPI for the released Python package, GitHub for source code and desktop installers, and conda-forge once its reviewed package is published.

scenes.narration: PyPI also links to the documentation, source repository, and issue tracker. Check the required Python versions and release date before changing an existing environment.
scenes.speech_text: pie pee also links to the documentation, source repository, and issue tracker. Check the required Python versions and release date before changing an existing environment.

scenes.narration: On GitHub, main is the released source line and nightly contains newer work still being tested. Use nightly only when you specifically need an unreleased change.
scenes.speech_text: On GitHub, main is the released source line and nightly contains newer work still being tested. Use nightly only when you specifically need an unreleased change.

scenes.narration: GitHub Releases provides the Windows, macOS, and Linux installers, release notes, Python package files, and SHA-256 checksums.
scenes.speech_text: GitHub Releases provides the Windows, macOS, and Linux installers, release notes, Python package files, and S H A two fifty six checksums.

scenes.narration: The conda-forge recipe is prepared in the repository, but no spaCR package is published on the conda-forge channel yet. For now, create a Conda environment and install spaCR from PyPI inside it.

scenes.narration: Use PyPI or pip for a Python environment, GitHub Releases for a native installer, and the nightly branch only for development. The next tutorials demonstrate each installation route without launching the application.

lessons.title: Installation with Conda
lessons.description: Create an isolated Python 3.12 environment and install the desktop or headless package into it.
objectives: Create and verify an isolated spaCR environment.
Choose the desktop or headless installation.
Validate the installation before launching spaCR.
lessons.prerequisite: Install Miniforge, Miniconda, Anaconda, or another Conda-compatible manager.

scenes.narration: A Conda environment keeps spaCR and its scientific dependencies separate from unrelated projects. Python three point twelve currently offers the broadest optional-package compatibility.
scenes.speech_text: A Conda environment keeps spacer and its scientific dependencies separate from unrelated projects. Python three point twelve currently offers the broadest optional-package compatibility.

scenes.narration: Open a Conda-enabled terminal and create an environment named spacr with Python three point twelve and pip.
scenes.speech_text: Open a Conda-enabled terminal and create an environment named spacer with Python three point twelve and pip.

scenes.narration: Activate the environment. Confirm that Python belongs to the spacr environment before installing anything.
scenes.speech_text: Activate the environment. Confirm that Python belongs to the spacer environment before installing anything.

scenes.narration: Upgrade pip through the active Python interpreter. Using python -m pip prevents a different pip executable from receiving the package.
scenes.speech_text: Upgrade pip through the active Python interpreter. Using python dash m pip prevents a different pip executable from receiving the package.

scenes.narration: For the desktop application, install spacr with the qt extra. Use the plain spacr package for a headless workstation or server.
scenes.speech_text: For the desktop application, install spacer with the qt extra. Use the plain spacer package for a headless workstation or server.

scenes.narration: Run spacr-doctor before the first launch. It reports the active installation, Qt, PyTorch, optional components, and hardware support with a suggested fix for every failed check.
scenes.speech_text: Run spacer doctor before the first launch. It reports the active installation, Qt, PyTorch, optional components, and hardware support with a suggested fix for every failed check.

scenes.narration: The conda-forge package is not published yet, so do not run conda install -c conda-forge spacr today. When it becomes available, the official recipe and channel will be linked from the spaCR repository.
scenes.speech_text: The conda-forge package is not published yet, so do not run conda install -c conda-forge spacer today. When it becomes available, the official recipe and channel will be linked from the spacer repository.

lessons.title: Installation with pip
lessons.description: Install spaCR into a standard virtual environment without using Conda.
objectives: Create a virtual environment on each supported operating system.
Install the correct spaCR package variant.
Verify the environment before launching the application.
lessons.prerequisite: Install a supported Python version; Python 3.12 is recommended.

scenes.narration: The pip route works on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Always use an isolated virtual environment rather than modifying the operating system's Python installation.
scenes.speech_text: The pip route works on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Always use an isolated virtual environment rather than modifying the operating system's Python installation.

scenes.narration: On macOS or Linux, create the environment with Python three point twelve, then activate it from its bin directory.
scenes.speech_text: On macOS or Linux, create the environment with Python three point twelve, then activate it from its bin directory.

scenes.narration: On Windows, use the Python launcher to create the environment and activate it from the Scripts directory.
scenes.speech_text: On Windows, use the Python launcher to create the environment and activate it from the Scripts directory.

scenes.narration: Upgrade pip in the active environment. The command python -m pip keeps installation tied to the Python you just activated.
scenes.speech_text: Upgrade pip in the active environment. The command python dash m pip keeps installation tied to the Python you just activated.

scenes.narration: Install the plain spacr package for headless use, or spacr with the qt extra for the desktop interface.
scenes.speech_text: Install the plain spacer package for headless use, or spacer with the qt extra for the desktop interface.

scenes.narration: Verify the imported version and run spacr-doctor. Resolve any failed checks before opening experimental data.
scenes.speech_text: Verify the imported version and run spacer doctor. Resolve any failed checks before opening experimental data.

scenes.narration: The environment is now ready. Keep it activated whenever you use spaCR, and use python -m pip install --upgrade spacr when you intentionally update it.
scenes.speech_text: The environment is now ready. Keep it activated whenever you use spacer, and use python dash m pip install dash dash upgrade spacer when you intentionally update it.
